form.title: PURCHASE AND SALE AGREEMENT

field.label: Financing
field.options: Cash, Bank, Owner, Blend, Show All

form.section: This Purchase and Sale Agreement is made as of (the "Effective Date") between (the "Buyer") and (the "Seller"). Brokers named in this Agreement facilitate the transaction and are not parties to the sale covenants except for the limited broker acknowledgment on the signature page. Each Party represents it has capacity and authority to bind itself.

Seller capacity is . If Married, the spouse shall join this Agreement and the escritura unless recorded capitulaciones or a court order provides otherwise. If Entity, the person signing warrants title and authority to bind the entity. If Attorney-in-fact, the poder is dated and shall be delivered in recordable form the Notary requires. The spouse signs on the signature page of this form.

Seller agrees to sell and Buyer agrees to buy the property known as , Municipality of , Catastro Number , Finca , Registry Section , Registry Entry (the "Property"), together with improvements and fixtures permanently attached to it, and any personal property listed in Additional Terms. The controlling legal description is the description in the last recorded escritura and the certified extract of the Registro de la Propiedad. A marketing name has no legal effect. Title shall be conveyed subject only to real-property taxes not yet due, recorded easements and servitudes that do not materially interfere with present use, association documents if any, and public coastal-zone and beach limitations of general application, plus exceptions Buyer does not timely object to (collectively, "Permitted Exceptions").

The purchase price is (the "Purchase Price"). The elected Transaction Type is . The Deposit of is held by and is credited to Buyer at Closing. The remaining Purchase Price may be paid in any combination of Bank Financed , Owner Financed , and Buyer Cash at Closing . Any unused leg is $0. Any one, two, or all three legs may be used. Deposit + Buyer Cash at Closing + Bank Financed + Owner Financed must equal the Purchase Price. Buyer shall pay in immediately available U.S. dollars, subject to prorations and required tax withholding.

Within three Business Days after the Effective Date, Buyer shall deliver the Deposit of by wire to . The Deposit is applied to the Purchase Price at Closing. It is refundable if Buyer timely terminates under a contingency this Agreement expressly treats as a refund-out (financing, appraisal if not waived, inspection, title, survey, casualty, condemnation, or Seller default). After those contingencies expire or are waived in writing, the Deposit is non-refundable except on Seller default. Neither Party shall rely on an email that changes wiring instructions. Wiring instructions shall be confirmed by a live telephone call to a number already known to the sender.

Closing means authorization of the escritura de compraventa before a Puerto Rico notary public, delivery of the Purchase Price net of credits and required withholdings, delivery of possession as provided herein, and presentation of the certified copy to the Registro de la Propiedad. Closing shall occur on or before before , or another Puerto Rico notary the Parties agree. The Closing Notary is a public officer and is not counsel for either Party. A mainland-style deed does not transfer Puerto Rico real property. Either Party may extend Closing by up to fifteen days if a title, Registry, or governmental certificate item is being cured in good faith. A longer extension requires a written amendment. This private contract does not itself transfer title. Title passes only upon authorization of the escritura de compraventa before a Puerto Rico notary and presentation to the Registro. The Notary, not this form, prepares the escritura and any hipoteca.

At Closing Seller shall convey good and marketable title, insurable at regular rates, free of liens other than Permitted Exceptions, by escritura publica acceptable for inscription. Seller shall cause a Puerto Rico title study and a standard title-insurance commitment to be delivered to Buyer at Seller's expense. Buyer shall give written title objections within ten days after receipt of the commitment. Seller shall have fifteen days to cure. Seller must cure monetary liens Seller created or assumed. If a timely objection is not cured and is not waived, Buyer may terminate and recover the Deposit. Seller shall deliver cancellation instruments needed to clear non-permitted liens and shall cooperate with presentation to the Registry.

Real-property taxes, CRIM charges, and municipal assessments shall be prorated as of the Closing Date. Seller shall pay items through the day of Closing and shall deliver a current CRIM certification of debt or evidence of payment arrangement acceptable to the Notary. Buyer pays items after Closing. Special assessments levied before the Effective Date are Seller's expense unless Additional Terms state otherwise.

section.title: Risk of Loss, Casualty and Condemnation

form.section: Risk of loss remains with Seller until Closing and passes to Buyer upon authorization of the escritura and delivery of possession. Seller shall maintain existing hazard coverage, and flood coverage if the Property is in a Special Flood Hazard Area, through Closing. If the Property suffers Material Casualty before Closing (repair cost exceeding five percent of the Purchase Price, or damage that cannot reasonably be repaired before Closing), Buyer may terminate and recover the Deposit, or proceed with assignment of insurance proceeds and a credit for any deductible. If any material part of the Property is taken or placed under a formal taking proceeding before Closing, Buyer may terminate and recover the Deposit or proceed and take the award.

Except for a failure to close on the Closing Date when time is of the essence and the other Party is ready, willing, and able, a Party is not in default until written notice and a five-day cure period have expired. If Buyer defaults, Seller may terminate and retain the Deposit as liquidated damages and not as a penalty. The Parties agree the Deposit is a reasonable pre-estimate of Seller's marketing, carrying, and opportunity losses. Retention of the Deposit is Seller's exclusive pre-Closing remedy for Buyer default. If Seller defaults, Buyer may terminate and recover the Deposit plus documented out-of-pocket title, survey, inspection, and lender fees, or seek specific performance, or terminate and pursue actual damages. Default under an owner-financed note after Closing is governed by that note and the hipoteca, not by the Deposit clause.

If Financing is Cash, Buyer's obligation to close is not conditioned on obtaining a loan. Failure to have immediately available funds on the Closing Date is a Buyer default. Within five Business Days after the Effective Date, Buyer shall deliver evidence reasonably acceptable to Seller that Buyer has liquid funds at least equal to the Purchase Price plus estimated Buyer-side closing costs. Seller shall keep that evidence confidential. Unless Appraisal Waived is No, any appraisal is for Buyer's information only and does not entitle Buyer to terminate or reprice.

If Financing is Bank or Blend, Buyer shall pursue a purchase-money first hipoteca from in the amount of . Buyer shall apply promptly, pursue the loan in good faith, and deliver a copy of the commitment letter to Seller within two Business Days after receipt. If, despite good-faith pursuit, Buyer does not receive a written commitment by , Buyer may terminate on or before that deadline and recover the Deposit. Silence after that deadline waives this contingency. If the lender's appraisal is less than the Purchase Price, Buyer shall within five Business Days elect to add cash, request a price reduction Seller may accept or refuse, or terminate and recover the Deposit. Seller has not promised that Buyer will qualify.

If Financing is Owner or Blend, at Closing title will pass to Buyer by escritura, and Seller will be secured by a civil-law hipoteca recorded in the Registry, not by retention of title. Seller-carried principal is at , maturing . The Parties shall execute a promissory note and an escritura de hipoteca before the Notary at Closing. Buyer shall keep the Property insured and shall pay CRIM when due. Remedies after Closing are as stated in the note and mortgage deed.

If Financing is Blend, the Purchase Price is paid in any combination of Bank Financed, Owner Financed, and Buyer Cash at Closing shown above. No leg is required if its amount is $0. Default lien stack when both loan legs are used: the institutional lender holds the first hipoteca in the amount of ; Seller holds the second hipoteca in the amount of . Seller shall execute the lender's commercially reasonable subordination so long as it does not increase the permitted first-lien principal above the stated bank loan amount plus ordinary protective advances. If the institutional loan funds at less than the stated bank amount, the shortfall is applied first as Buyer additional cash, then as an increase in the seller note only with Seller's written consent, then as a price reduction only with Seller's written consent, and otherwise Buyer may terminate and recover the Deposit. Sale, first hipoteca, and second hipoteca shall be authorized in one session so priority is clear on presentation to the Registry.

Appraisal Waived is . If Yes, value is not a Buyer termination right except as the Bank module provides when a lender requires an appraisal. If No, Buyer may terminate and recover the Deposit if a licensed appraisal delivered before Closing concludes that as-is market value is less than ninety-five percent of the Purchase Price and the Parties do not agree in writing on a reduced price or credit within three Business Days.

Buyer may obtain a new survey at Buyer's cost, with objections due by . A survey objection is a title objection if it shows an encroachment, lack of record access, a material cabida variance, or an improvement outside the Registry bounds.

Buyer may inspect the Property, at Buyer's cost, through (the "Inspection Period"). A Material Defect is a condition that is not readily visible, that materially and adversely affects safety, structure, weather-tightness, or permitted use, and that will cost more than one percent of the Purchase Price to repair. Buyer shall give written notice of claimed Material Defects before the Inspection Period expires. Seller shall within five Business Days elect to repair, credit, or refuse. If Seller refuses and the Parties do not agree, Buyer may terminate within three Business Days and recover the Deposit, or proceed as-is.
Optional deal-specific financing notes.
Additional negotiated terms of the transaction.
Special conditions negotiated by the parties.

The following items, if used, are separate addenda outside this form and control if attached and signed by Buyer and Seller: Exhibit A, legal description from the last escritura; Exhibit B, personal-property and vessel inventory; Exhibit C, owner-finance term sheet (note and hipoteca); Exhibit D, seller property condition disclosure. An unsigned exhibit is not part of this Agreement.

Culebra deals often involve items that belong in an addendum if they are part of the bargain: a leased or PPA solar system Seller does not own; a dock, mooring, or maritime concession; vacation guests through Closing; unpermitted cistern, septic, generator, or shoreline work; flood insurance if a lender is involved; and any HOA, co-owner, or concession right of first refusal. Disclose those items in Exhibit D or Additional Terms. Silence in this form is not a representation that none exist.

Unless a signed post-closing occupancy addendum states otherwise, Seller shall deliver exclusive possession at Closing, broom-clean, free of occupants and of personal property not included in Additional Terms.

All fixtures permanently attached to the Property are included, including solar arrays, inverters, and batteries hard-wired to the house. Appliances, furnishings, vehicles, and vessels are included only if listed in Additional Terms or Exhibit B.

section.title: Condition of Property and Seller Representations

form.section: Except as required by law and except for the representations in this section and any written Seller disclosure, the Property is sold in its present as-is condition. Seller representations in this section survive Closing for twelve months.
Buyer may inspect the Property within forty-eight hours before Closing. The walkthrough is not a second inspection contingency.
Taxes, rents if any, HOA dues, utilities, and similar recurring charges shall be prorated as of the Closing Date. This clause survives Closing.
If the Property is subject to a homeowners or similar regime, Seller shall deliver current governing documents, budget, and a statement of account.
Seller shall maintain utility service through Closing. Buyer shall arrange transfer effective the Closing Date.

Each Party may retain independent counsel. Closing shall be conducted before a Puerto Rico notary public. The Notary is not counsel for either Party. Electronic signature of this private contract does not replace the notarial formalities of the escritura or hipoteca.

A transfer of Puerto Rico real property can trigger Hacienda withholding and federal FIRPTA withholding. Buyer can be personally liable for a required amount that is not withheld. Seller's Puerto Rico residency certification is . Seller's FIRPTA foreign-person status is . Seller shall deliver the certificates the Notary and Escrow Holder require before Closing. If any part of the Purchase Price is paid after Closing under owner financing, Buyer shall withhold from each later payment to the extent the statute requires. This clause survives Closing.
Buyer may not assign this Agreement without Seller's prior written consent, except to an entity that Buyer controls. No assignment releases Buyer.
Buyer acknowledges Culebra property can be affected by coastal-zone regulation, public-beach access, FEMA flood mapping, and storm risk.
Either Party may structure its side as an exchange under Internal Revenue Code section 1031. The other Party shall cooperate at no material cost or delay.

The brokers named in this Agreement are (Buyer's broker) and (Seller's broker). Broker representation on this transaction is . If representation is Both, the named broker is a dual agent and each Party consents to that dual agency. Commission is paid under separate listing and buyer-representation agreements.

If a natural-person Party dies or becomes legally incapacitated before Closing, this Agreement binds the estate or representative. Named-storm, earthquake, or Registry or notary closure moves Closing to the third Business Day after the impediment lifts, not later than thirty days after the original Closing Date.
All notices under this Agreement shall be in writing and delivered by hand, overnight courier, or email with a PDF attached.
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico. Exclusive venue lies in the Court of First Instance of Puerto Rico.
This Agreement, including any addenda signed by Buyer and Seller, constitutes the entire agreement. Amendments must be in writing and signed by Buyer and Seller.
This Agreement may be signed in counterparts. Electronic delivery of a signed counterpart is effective for this private contract.
If any provision is held unenforceable, the remainder continues in effect.
Time is of the essence. Deadlines that fall on a weekend or legal holiday in Puerto Rico run to the next Business Day. Atlantic Time controls.
